text: also, zooming in i realized doesnt make the map go away but it resets position so hard ur out in the middle of no where when u do it same with zooming out
resolution: Zoom-to-cursor was flinging the iso camera into empty space on both zoom-in and zoom-out. Root cause: zoomToCursor anchored the cursor's world point with unprojectGround, which marches the ray only to MAX_T≈400m, but the iso eye sits BASE_DIST/zoom metres from the target — up to ~750m at MIN_ZOOM — so a zoomed-out cursor ray never reached the ground and the march bailed to its cam.target fallback; the before/after delta was then garbage and shoved centreX/Z far off the map. Fix replaces the anchor with an analytic ray/plane intersection at the active level elevation (new IsoStage.groundPoint), which is distance-independent and has no march cap, and no-ops the shift if either solve is degenerate; dragPan now rides the same path. The map never disappeared (that was a separate report) — this is purely the position-reset-on-zoom. Committed in 3be6fb8b9, bundles clean.
